explication: Hekate/Nyx is a graphical Nintendo Switch bootloader and recovery toolkit. The principal workflow is: a user selects or configures an entry, Hekate reads boot configuration and storage, then launches HOS, Android/Linux, or another payload; alternatively it enters Nyx for tools and hardware management. Nyx handles touchscreen/Joy-Con interaction and display rendering, while platform drivers provide storage, USB, power, and memory services. The tree supports these major capabilities, but several GUI integrations are represented at directory level because their implementations were not sampled.
